### Changing the Data in a Patient Record's Profile {#sec-solution-17}

The data that describes the patient rather than a single hospital stay, such as the sex, the birth weight or whether the infant is part of a multiple birth, is shown in the 'Profile' widget of the Tracked Entity Instance Dashboard (see @sec-solution-1).

To change it, click 'Edit' in the heading of the 'Profile' widget, correct the fields concerned, for example 'Multiple birth' or 'Number of infants in birth', and click 'Save'.
'Cancel' leaves the profile as it was.
